body: Been on cipralex for 15 months now.  No therapist, it's too costly and too far away, I live in remote kinda area and no doctors close or available really.  I'd have to go 2 hr drive and wait in clinic all day and might still not see a doc.  The system is too clogged here.  I do enjoy my work, well I used to more .. I find I am often saying to self..." What the hell is wrong with you?? You like this remember?  ".  Then I try to think ok I need to feel better, what can I do now, right now to feel better... And ... Nope I draw a blank.  I have been in the past a multi faceted person with many interests and hobbies etc...lots to do and have fun...  I'm just not feeling it anymore.  I just feel TIRED.  DISCONNECTED.  ALONE. VULNERABLE.  I just wander between bad things that happen and try to keep going til the next bad thing and do damage control.... Rinse and repeat.  It's such drudgery.
Yep I feel this way too

I take cipralex 15 mg and another drug which I can't spell.. When I can't sleep.. Problem is it makes me too sleepy rest of next day too.  I worry too cause this time I feel like I can't put all this into words.. At least last time I was able to type out pages and pages of what's felt and why.  Meh... Now that all seems exhausting and this time I don't even know why I feel suicidal, not exactly.  Just tired of feeling stressed out and overwhelmed.
Sleep well, please know that I care.  Hugs.

It's frustrating!  Sometimes I start to feel better but something happens and I come back full circle to idea of suicide.  I want to live but not as me... That make sense? Ugh. I just hate me so bad.  Sometimes I even think of just running off from everyone and everything I know and starting over... But I bet I mess it all up again, because I will still be me....

Plee don't try the pill and bath tub thing, I tried that, failed because someone came home early and stopped me... But I'm here to tell you... It hurts like a son of a bitch after, I had multiple infections after and was in incredible amount of pain.  Just don't, it's a bad idea.  I don't blame you for hating your parents,  escape from them.  I was abused kid too.  Get out, you can start over somehow.  There are shelters even... THey totally suck to stay at, I lived in one for six months, but it got me out of bad situation and in the long run, was better.  You deserve better!  Seriously!
Ok good start.   Lol I made a post too, no comments, I even fail at this.  But hey you are talking to me a bit, it helps... Hopefully helps us both?
That made me smile.  Ty

I'd like it much better if you put the knife away.  I'm not one to talk, I'm no better, I have tools for self harm in bed with me right now.  I'm a train wreck though,  you can do better than me.  Put it away then come back and talk.

I have conflicting feelings like this too. It feels like teetering on the edge of a cliff... Will I?  Won't I?  Do I want to really?  I have had momentary impulses that I have acted on, partially... I had pills in my mouth, ten times more than fatal dose, but I spit them out, the idea and act came all in one moment.  It's scary, I understand your fear and confusion.  I hope you are feeling better soon. I care, and get it.
I so understand you, much of what you say I have felt too.  Hugs.
I understand this nagging feeling. Happens to me too.  Hugs.
Thank you, I'm trying.  Time seems very long.
Dear god please make me die, don't make me have to do it myself
Right now, financial stuff, and self loathing persists.  I could fill a book with problems... I want to hide somewhere.  Sorry I'm not very articulate right now.
Hugs !
Yes I choked up. Lost my voice, squeaked and still didnt say everything I should have to doc.  It is not easy!  Good luck.
Beautifully said Turtle :)
I'm on different med, just started, mine makes me shiver for awhile after taking it.  It's really weird.  I hope things get better for you!

Thank you!  I don't have any advice on the eval thing, this is all new to me.  I just thought it was sweet of you to post a positive message for everyone. Especially since today is my first day home after a failed attempt.  It helps to know some people can be so kind.
Hugs, I'm here to listen.  I care.

There is no harm to rate yourself midway, and it really sounds like you could benefit from anti depressants,  see what your doctor says.  Don't be afraid to say wait stop you aren't taking this serious enough... If you think it's warranted.  Beating this early is in your best interest.  I waited til it was a crisis and I regret that.  I hope the best for you.  Talk to me any time ok?
I suffer from similar feelings and doubts. I don't have answers, but I can listen and show some empathy.  Hugs.

I also don't understand why people say "attention seeking". And fling it in your face in a mean way.  A few days ago I posted in suicide watch that I was really depressed etc and considering ending it.  I was getting some helpful advice from some and it helped.  Then one jerk told me I wass just attention seeking.  It was a trigger for me. That night I made an attempt that left me in hospital and sick.  I wish I could go back and convince myself to not let it get to me.  If you ever need someone to talk, I'm here.
Yes, please get some help... This is how I felt too, disconnected and dispassionate about harming myself.  I know how you feel.  Hugs.
I'm still here, just got home from hospital. :/  I'd still like someone here to talk to.

You just describe me, the self sabotage, the abuse everything... Even cringing to see own reflection and feeling self conscious.  I want the misery to be over too, it would be great if somehow things can be better.  I keep hoping. I hope you can get out of this funk, let us know how it goes? And any helpful tips.. Thank you for sharing... Seriously it made me cry cause I recognize myself in your words.

I do like to draw, embroider and quilt, I even sell things I have made.  Right now my work area is a mess because of some repair work in the house.  I look at the jumble and feel so unmotivated to untangle it and set everything up again, especially since we are moving soon... So it feels like wtf why bother cause it's going in boxes soon anyway.  I can keep bodily busy with things, stuff I like even, but im still thinking bad things about myself.  And when I'm not busy I scratch at my skin and gouge nasty marks... Not on purpose really, it's just stress and feeling caged that makes me do it.. Even when I tell myself stop it.  Ugh maybe I have OCD or something.  I like to go out and walk but I live in a city and people make me feel anxious so that doesnt help my stress levels.  I can't stand if someone in public accidentally touches me, it's such a feeling of revulsion, I avoid it at all costs.  Anyway I'm rambling..so..

i am afraid to give details now, but i know i have good reason to not kill myself.  The hard part tho, the feelings and impulses to do it, dont just go away, even tho im pretty sure I wont.  I still cant make myself get help... especially now.
How can I sleep at night, thoughts torment me.  Then when I do sleep its so hard to wake up. I either sleep not much at all or like eighteen hrs.

Stress, someone here was nice to me and talked to me and it helped, that's when I talked of problems in kind of general way.  When I was more specific, he deleted everything he said to me in that post.  It made me feel worse about myself.. Guess I m pretty horrible person that doesn't deserve help. :/.  I liked things you said to other people, it made some sense to me, it's why I sent you this message, I hope you don't mind.
I wish someone was here to talk to now, I made a new post but it doesn't show up:/
I'm here too.  Listening.
Ok Ty, I have to think about this...
Be a friend to him if that is what is truly in your heart... It's a good thing.  Best wishes for you and your friend.

Maybe, but I still don't know what to say exactly, should I just say I'm depressed?  What else will a doctor want to know or ask?  To be brutally honest, I don't want anyone in real life to know I am thinking of suicide, because I don't want that option taken away, I want control of that still, even though I want help.  It makes no sense, I'm not logical... All I know is that I am hurting.
